name: WASOP3 call for proposals: conservation, restoration and resilience of marine and coastal ecosystems in West Africa

administered_by.name: Regional Partnership for Coastal and Marine Conservation in West Africa (PRCM)

summary: An EU-funded call under the West Africa Sustainable Ocean Programme, coordinated by IUCN and run by PRCM, for marine and coastal conservation, habitat and species restoration, MPA management, nature-based adaptation and conservation-compatible blue economy projects in 13 West African countries.

amount.note: Up to €60,000 in category 1 and €100,000 in category 2

administered_by.quote: Organiser of the call: Regional Partnership for Coastal and Marine Conservation in West Africa (PRCM)

applicant_types.quote: The call is aimed in particular at civil society organisations and national NGOs, community and socio-professional organisations, conservation area managers, local authorities, relevant public institutions, universities and national research institutions

geography.quote: The call covers the thirteen WASOP beneficiary countries: Benin, Cabo Verde, Côte d'Ivoire, The Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Liberia, Mauritania, Nigeria, Senegal, Sierra Leone and Togo.

access.quote: The call is organised as a single-stage procedure, based on the direct submission of a complete proposal.

amount.quote: 20 projects; maximum funding of EUR 60,000 per project 17 projects; maximum funding of EUR 100,000 per project

co_finance_required.quote: The lead applicant and its partners must secure co-funding amounting to at least 10 per cent of this budget.

eligibility.quote: The WASOP3 call for proposals is open to legally constituted or recognised organisations and institutions established in one of the thirteen beneficiary countries of the programme and possessing the necessary legal capacity to enter into a grant agreement, receive funding and manage it.
Private, for-profit companies are not eligible as lead applicants

Applicants or partners who find themselves in a situation incompatible with the responsible management of a grant are excluded, in particular in cases of fraud, corruption, false declarations, insolvency or serious breaches of previous contractual obligations.
A single organisation may submit only one proposal as lead partner.
Projects must be implemented in the marine, coastal or littoral areas of beneficiary countries and contribute directly to the objectives and priorities of WASOP3.
Projects devoted exclusively to academic research, training or communication, without direct application to conservation, restoration or resilience, are not eligible.
The maximum implementation period is set at 24 months, regardless of the funding category.

documents.quote: The proposal must include the duly completed application form, the detailed and justified budget, the logical framework, the timetable, the declarations by the lead applicant and, where applicable, those by the partners, as well as the required legal, administrative, financial, environmental and social documents.

co_finance.quote: The lead applicant and its partners must secure co-funding amounting to at least 10 per cent of this budget.

eligibility.rule: Legally constituted organisation based in a WASOP country, able to sign and manage a grant
Lead applicant is not a private for-profit company
Not in fraud, corruption, insolvency or serious breach of past contracts
Submits no other proposal as lead partner
Project is in marine, coastal or littoral areas of a beneficiary country
Project is not solely academic research, training or communication
Project lasts no more than 24 months

documents: Signed declarations by the lead applicant and any partners
Legal, administrative, financial, environmental and social documents
